content.intro: This lesson introduces free-threaded python and experimental performance features as part of modern python and version compatibility. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: External systems fail or return unexpected data. Validate responses, use parameterized queries, set timeouts, manage transactions, and avoid exposing credentials.
